snippet.title: Arkheron | Xbox Gamescom Trailer
snippet.description:
Arkheron is coming to console in our Crossplay Beta Test. Get a closer look at Arkheron’s ability-based PvP combat, Eternals Item sets, plus our 3v3 combat arena and 45-player game modes, with gameplay and insights directly from the Bonfire Studios team.

Sign up and play: https://arkheron.com/

Chapters:
00:00-01:26 | Gameplay Intro
01:27-01:38 | Arkheron is Coming to Console
01:39-02:04 | What is Arkheron?
02:05-03:05 | How Does Combat Work?
03:06-04:04 | Eternals and Item Set Builds
04:05-04:35 | Game Modes: Spires
04:36-05:29 | Game Modes: Ascension
05:30-06:19 | Gameplay of Final Ascension Fight
06:20-06:44 | Crossplay Beta
